# Manglam Event

> Manglam Event is a full-service wedding and event planning company based in Sitamarhi, Bihar, India. Founded in 2014, we specialise in luxury weddings, destination weddings, corporate events, concerts, artist management, floral decor, and photography/videography.

## About

Manglam Event was founded in 2014 in Sitamarhi, Bihar, India. We are Bihar's most trusted event management company, having delivered over 500 events with a 4.9/5 client rating. We serve clients across Bihar — including Sitamarhi, Patna, Muzaffarpur, Darbhanga, Motihari, and Vaishali — and operate pan-India for destination events.

**Founder:** Manglam Event team, Sitamarhi, Bihar  
**Established:** 2014  
**Headquarters:** Cinema Road, Near Vishal Mega Mart, Sitamarhi, Bihar – 843302, India  
**Phone:** +91 76350 31522  
**Email:** info@manglamevents.in  
**Website:** https://manglamevents.in  

## Services

- **Luxury Wedding Planning** — Bespoke mandaps, floral architecture, sangeet to vidaai coordination
- **Destination Wedding Planning** — Pan-India including Rajasthan, Goa, Kerala, Himachal Pradesh
- **Corporate Events** — Conferences, product launches, award nights, brand experiences
- **Concerts & DJ Nights** — Stage, sound, lighting, crowd management for live events
- **Public & Cultural Events** — Large-scale production with AV infrastructure and logistics
- **Artist Management** — Booking and managing Bollywood artists, folk singers, DJs, comedians
- **Photography & Videography** — Candid, traditional, drone coverage, pre-wedding shoots, wedding films
- **Floral & Decor Design** — Immersive themed installations, luxury mandap decor, entrance design

## Service Area

Primary: Sitamarhi, Bihar, India

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What does Manglam Event do?**  
A: Manglam Event is a full-service event planning and management company in Bihar, India. We plan and execute weddings, destination weddings, corporate events, concerts, cultural events, and provide photography, floral decor, and artist management services.

**Q: Which cities does Manglam Event serve?**  
A: We are based in Sitamarhi, Bihar and serve all of Bihar including Patna, Muzaffarpur, Darbhanga, Motihari, and surrounding districts. We also plan destination weddings and events across India.

**Q: How much does wedding planning cost at Manglam Event?**  
A: Packages start from ₹2 lakh for intimate ceremonies and go up to ₹50 lakh+ for luxury destination weddings. We offer customised packages based on guest count, venue, decor, and services selected.

**Q: How do I book Manglam Event?**  
A: You can contact us via WhatsApp at +91 76350 31522, email info@manglamevents.in, or fill out the inquiry form on our website at https://manglamevents.in. We respond within 2 hours and offer a free first consultation.

**Q: Does Manglam Event plan destination weddings?**  
A: Yes. We plan destination weddings across India including Rajasthan palaces, Goa beaches, Kerala backwaters, and Himachal hill stations. Our team handles logistics, vendor coordination, travel, and decor at any location.

**Q: Do you provide photography and videography?**  
A: Yes. We offer complete photo and film packages including candid photography, drone coverage, pre-wedding shoots, and cinematic wedding films.

**Q: Can you manage celebrity or artist bookings?**  
A: Yes. We handle bookings for Bollywood artists, folk singers, DJs, standup comedians, and celebrity performers for weddings, corporate events, and concerts.
